description: Hand-verified ground truth for issue #271's misattribution rate investigation, reused as the false-negative-rate ground truth for #267. 50 records: first 5 (in file order) from each of the 10 LoCoMo conversations, drawn from the 147-record 'not-in-db AND long-answer' target set. Each record was read against its raw evidence turn(s) from sample.json AND, for classes (a)/(c), cross-checked against the real production store (memory.sqlite.pre-encryption.bak).

classes.a: FALSE_NEGATIVE — the fact IS correctly stored in the atom store, just worded differently from the gold answer (or split across two atoms). diagnose-retrieval.mts's not-in-db verdict is wrong for these.
classes.b: GENUINE_GAP_REACTION_OPINION — the interpersonal-praise/reaction class the extraction prompt's old 'sentiment padding' rule told the model to skip. See astramemory-local#269 (now fixed for this class).
classes.c: GENUINE_GAP_GRANULAR_SPECIFIC — the headline topic IS captured as an atom, but a specific one-off detail (a number, a quoted phrase, a date) named in the gold answer is missing from that atom's text.
classes.d: GENUINELY_ABSENT_OTHER — no atom anywhere in the project has related content. No confirmed single mechanism; candidates found in follow-up tracing include advice/counsel content dropped, misattribution to the wrong speaker, and (once) an image-pixel-only fact with no textual/caption source.

known_correction: conv-50#90 (Calvin, 'gives them a fresh vibe') was originally hand-labeled 'd' in the first pass. A later, deeper trace (see astramemory-local#271/#273 investigation thread) found the headline fact IS stored ('Calvin has been experimenting with different music genres lately, including adding electronic elements to his songs') — only the specific descriptive phrase 'gives them a fresh vibe' is missing. Correct label is 'c', not 'd'. Left both labels in this file (see 'label' and 'corrected_label') so downstream consumers can reproduce either version.

worked_example.question: Why did Caroline choose the adoption agency?
worked_example.gold_answer: because of their inclusivity and support for LGBTQ+ individuals
worked_example.stored_atom_text: Caroline chose an adoption agency because it helps LGBTQ+ folks with adoption and its inclusivity and support appealed to her.
worked_example.label: a
worked_example.note: Semantically correct, stored verbatim-equivalent. diagnose-retrieval.mts's token-containment score for this pair is 0.5 (folks!=individuals, its!=their) -- below the 0.6 threshold -- which is why it was misclassified not-in-db.
